name: exo
systemHint: This external `exo` CLI is a daemon debugging/admin tool. The native `exo` only starts/aborts subagents; use this CLI for administration, worktree targeting, or transcription. See `exo -h`, `exo models`, and README.md. Subagents start in the configured global working directory; include the project's absolute directory when relevant. Never restart the main daemon.
